sections.heading: Company
sections.content: Kano Therapeutics harnesses the power of DNA nanotechnology and synthetic biology to design and engineer novel gene constructs. Our goal is to expand the reach of genome-editing-based therapies through the development of transformational biomaterials. Instead of innovating around the messenger (gene delivery systems, gene editing tools), we start by innovating around the message - the DNA payload that carries the genetic information.

sections.heading: Open Apply
sections.content: At Kano, we’re always seeking talented people to join our team. If you’re excited by our vision but don’t see a role that’s an exact fit don’t hesitate to reach out. Submit your CV and introduce yourself! If we think there could be a match we will follow up.
